ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.label: down in the mud

texts.li: {B_nameDef} slipped in the mud, grabbed {A_nameDef} on the way down, and they both ended up sitting in it, laughing too hard to get up.
{A_nameDef} reached out to steady {B_nameDef} on the wet ground, and they went down together, face first.
{B_nameDef} lost a boot to the mud, and {A_nameDef} lost {A_possessive} dignity pulling it out.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} came in caked in mud to the knees, and neither would say who fell first.

ColonyCouncil.SocialEventDef.note: went down in the mud together
